en: Labuan — a Straits Settlement from 1907 until 1946, not company territory
Malacca — Straits Settlement, a Crown colony ruled from Singapore
Singapore — Straits Settlement, and the capital of the colony
Penang — Straits Settlement, with Province Wellesley on the mainland
Christmas Island — annexed 1888, attached to the Straits Settlements in 1900 and run from Singapore, worked for phosphate
